query: Which apixaban dose was studied for stroke prevention in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation in the pivotal trial?

pubmed.title: ARISTOTLE: apixaban 5 mg twice daily versus warfarin
pubmed.summary: Apixaban 5 mg twice daily reduced stroke or systemic embolism versus warfarin in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation. A 2.5 mg twice-daily dose was used only for specific dose-reduction criteria.

dailymed.title: Apixaban tablet label — recommended dose 5 mg twice daily
dailymed.summary: Recommended dose is 5 mg orally twice daily. Reduce to 2.5 mg twice daily when two or more dose-reduction characteristics are present.

cochrane.title: Review of DOAC dosing in atrial fibrillation
cochrane.summary: Systematic review emphasises that efficacy conclusions for apixaban in AF refer primarily to the 5 mg twice-daily regimen.
